problem_statement: HR teams spend excessive manual effort collecting and filing new employee documents, causing delays to system access provisioning.

requirements.text: New employees can submit their personal details, tax forms, and right-to-work documents through a self-service portal.
HR managers can review submitted documents and approve or request corrections.
The system shall notify IT provisioning when onboarding is complete.
